THE CHARACTER, GOBLIN CHIEFTAIN (an elite, bigger and broader than a normal goblin): a burly olive-green goblin (#6f7a3a skin) with long sideways ears, a fierce underbite with tusks, a CROWN OF BONES (a ring of small pale bone spikes and teeth) on its head, a shaggy dark fur mantle over its shoulders, a battered iron chest plate and a rope belt with trinkets. In its RIGHT hand a heavy jagged iron cleaver. Never draw any letters, words or numbers anywhere, not even on the banner. Muted olive, fur brown, dull iron, bone white, the dark banner cloth.

Row 2 (middle, 4 figures): (5) ATTACK windup: the cleaver raised high over its head, the banner held behind it, mouth open roaring; (6) ATTACK strike: the cleaver chopped down in front, body lunging forward, the banner still upright; (7) BURNING: the character is ON FIRE, orange-yellow pixel flames licking up from its head, shoulders and back, arms flailing up, mouth wide open screaming, its body lit orange; (8) BURNING: running in panic in a different flailing pose, flames on its back and head.
Row 3 (bottom, 3 figures) DEATH: (9) hit, recoiling backward, eyes squeezed shut; (10) knees buckling, falling, weapon dropping; (11) collapsed, lying flat on the ground as a low heap seen from the front.
Every figure stands alone with wide magenta gaps to every other figure; nothing touches or overlaps; each weapon stays inside its own figure's space.
